name: Being In Debt
overview: Scripture reveals that being in debt places one in a position of servitude, as the borrower becomes subject to the lender's authority, contrasting with God's blessing of lending rather than borrowing (Deuteronomy 15:6; Proverbs 22:7). The Bible warns against rash financial commitments and guarantees, urging careful planning and avoidance of suretyship for others' debts (Proverbs 22:26; Luke 14:28). Furthermore, indebtedness can conflict with wholehearted devotion to God, since one cannot serve both God and mammon (Matthew 6:24), and the righteous are called to act justly by repaying what they owe and showing mercy (Psalms 37:21).
